newsitem.title: USA: USLIFE to redeem Series A and B preferred.
newsitem.headline: USLIFE to redeem Series A and B preferred.

text.p: USLIFE Corp said Wednesday it has called for the redemption on May 9 of all outstanding shares of its series A and B preferred stock.
It said that the $4.50 convertible preferred series A stock will be redeemed at $100.87 a share including accrued and unpaid dividends of 87 cents a share.
The $5.00 convertible preferred series B stock will be redeemed at $100.96 a share including accrued and unpaid dividends of 96 cents a share, it said.
It said that each series A preferred share is convertible into 12 common shares and each series B share into 11.99 common shares at any time up to 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on May 9.

Based upon the reported last sale price on the New York Stock Exchange on March 31 of $46.625 a common share, the market value of the common shares obtained if a series A preferred share was converted would be $559.50. For series B, the value would be $559.03 if a Series B share was converted into common stock, based on the same closing price.
USLIFE is a life insurance-based holding company with 11 wholly owned subsidiaries. The company has $178 billion of life insurance in force and nearly $8 billion in assets.
